headline: Vr Infraspace wins Rs 1.45 crore road work order from Panchayat R&B
summary: Vr Infraspace secured a Rs 1.45 crore confirmed order for road improvement in Amreli. The company's TTM revenue is reported as zero, highlighting a disconnect between recent order inflows and recognized earnings.

headline: Bhadora Industries wins Rs 9.62 Cr order for cable supply
summary: Bhadora Industries secured a Rs 9.62 crore work order from a domestic energy infrastructure company. This adds to a Q3FY27 inflow of Rs 77.28 crore, boosting the order book against low current revenue visibility.

headline: Presstonic wins Rs 1.48 Cr order from Titagarh for Mumbai Metro
summary: Presstonic Engineering secures Rs 1.48 Cr work order from Titagarh Rail Systems for Mumbai Metro Line 6 cable ducts. Order book coverage remains tight with Q3 inflow at Rs 1.42 Cr.

headline: CUDML secures Rs 7.01 cr railway ad order
summary: Cash Ur Drive Marketing has secured a Rs 7.01 crore order from Northern Railway for advertising rights at Chandigarh Station. This significant deal adds to its recent order inflows, which totaled Rs 23.28 crore over the last three quarters.

headline: PTC Industries to meet Franklin Templeton, SBI Life
summary: PTC Industries will host institutional investors including Franklin Templeton and SBI Life in Lucknow on November 27, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Tarai Foods Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹16.7 lakh
summary: Tarai Foods reported a net loss of ₹16.7 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹12.2 lakh in Q2FY26, with zero revenue from operations for the quarter.

headline: Coal India subsidiary MCL files IPO prospectus
summary: Mahanadi Coalfield Limited filed its IPO prospectus with RoC Odisha on November 23, 2026. The offer involves up to 66.18 crore equity shares via Offer for Sale.

headline: PTC Industries to host investor meetings in Asia
summary: PTC Industries Ltd will conduct one-on-one investor meetings in Singapore and Hong Kong from November 30 to December 3, 2026.
